# gambit

> A dependency-free Go chess library and CLI: two agents play each other, logged in algebraic notation. The core models the board, generates legal moves, parses FEN, and verifies itself with perft.

The chess library is importable as `github.com/danielriddell21/gambit/pkg/chess`. It has no external dependencies. The `gambit` command (`cmd/gambit`) drives two agents to play a game; it runs headless by default and, when built with `-tags ebiten`, renders the game in a window.

Core library API:

```go
type Board struct{ /* ... */ }

func NewStartingBoard() *Board
func ParseFEN(fen string) (*Board, error)
func (b *Board) LegalMoves() []Move
func (b *Board) MakeMove(m Move) Undo
func Perft(b *Board, depth int) uint64

type Move uint16   // packed from/to/flag
type Color uint8   // White, Black
type Result uint8  // ongoing, checkmate, stalemate, draw
```

Agents (in `internal/agent`) implement a common interface and are selectable by name on the CLI (`--white`, `--black`): random, minimax, beam, mcts, and others. Use `--help` to list flags.
